''See also: [[Valinhall Gate Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|A [[Valinhall]] Gate serves as a [[portal]] connecting the external world to [[the House]] of [[Valinhall]]. These gateways typically manifest when a [[Traveler]] slices through reality, creating a white-edged, swirling doorway that resembles a curtain being drawn back. While these portals can be opened from any location in the real world, they consistently lead to the same destination: the [[entry hall]] of [[Valinhall]]. This characteristic makes the territory difficult to use for efficient travel, as any subsequent Gate opened from within [[Valinhall]] will return the user to the exact location where they first entered. Under normal circumstances, a Gate stabilizes after being opened, but its appearance can vary; for instance, it may appear ragged or shrink in size. Specialized tools and artifacts influence their state, such as the [[black gauntlet]] known as a [[gatecrawler]], which can tear open recently closed or closing [[Gates]]. Conversely, certain artifacts like the [[frozen horn]] possess the ability to close them. While a single Gate can be opened, multiple [[Gates]] may also manifest simultaneously, causing them to slide past one another rather than overlap.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The [[Valinhall]] Gate serves as a one-way [[portal]] used for movement, providing [[Simon]] with a potential location to retreat toward. While these gates can be cut open, they can only be held open by a full [[Traveler]] utilizing his assigned [[Dragon's Fang|Dragon’s Fang]]. During the conflict, [[Denner Weeks|Denner]] demonstrates the ability to slice into a gate with his sword. [[Simon]] later attempts to use Azura to cut into the [[portal]], eventually succeeding by slicing downward into the gate.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|A [[Valinhall]] Gate can be opened from any location outside by a [[Traveler]] who slices the space from top to bottom, creating a swirling doorway with white edges. While the process of opening such a gate takes a long time, these portals always lead directly to the [[entry hall]] of [[the House]]. Near [[Leah's camp]], residue from an old gate can be found, and [[Indirial]] possesses the ability to cut one open. During his time in a tent, [[Simon]] attempts to slice a gate, which eventually results in the gates being successfully opened. Ultimately, two [[Valinhall]] [[Gates]] are opened at the same time within the [[entry hall]].}}
